## AC3 satisfied — all three entries now reach `done` [non-codebase]

provenance: environment=local-macos-checkout; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the three entries were driven through the drain's own per-item sequence (`enrich()` -> `digest_sidecar.emit()` -> `queue.mark_done()`) using the FIXED build at `origin/main` 8ad5182910, against the live store at `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker` and the real Bedrock provider, with the same config the detached drain child loads.

```
8625-7bea-67db-4cdc: enriched+done in 16.3s  done=True pending=False
9305-b42c-3262-4c58: enriched+done in 21.1s  done=True pending=False
e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2: enriched+done in 23.3s  done=True pending=False
```

Post-state on the live store — each now carries a DONE tombstone and a FRESH digest, and none
is pending:

```
8625-7bea-67db-4cdc done=True pending=False digest=present-fresh
9305-b42c-3262-4c58 done=True pending=False digest=present-fresh
e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2 done=True pending=False digest=present-fresh
```

The claim/done counters make the before-and-after unambiguous. Earlier in this session they
read **435/7, 430/11, 424/12** — hundreds of claims against a handful of completions, the
signature of the infinite re-claim loop. They now read:

```
8625-7bea-67db-4cdc claims=435 dones=8
9305-b42c-3262-4c58 claims=430 dones=12
e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2 claims=424 dones=13
```

The claim counters stopped moving and each gained exactly one DONE — the first completions
these entries have had since 2026-08-14. They were the largest tickets in the store
(8,539,143 / 6,166,714 / 2,992,643 assembled characters); every one of those attempts had
been rejected with `prompt is too long: 206826 tokens > 200000 maximum`.

Note this ALSO restores store-wide overlap detection for them: `overlap.wire` calls `enrich()`
for the query digest and fails open on any error, so before the fix these tickets produced no
overlap findings at all — not merely a stale cached digest.

The starvation issue recorded against AC3 earlier (898 pending entries, these at sorted
indices 458/499/786 behind a batch cap of 5) is unchanged and remains a genuine separate
defect, filed and linked as `f400-987f-45f6-419a` (sainted-regardable-burro). It governs how
soon the *rest* of the backlog drains; it no longer blocks these three.
